hero.eyebrow: The specialist job market for Egyptian real estate
hero.title: Egypt's best real estate jobs platform
hero.subtitle: Every listing here states the basic salary, the commission, and who supplies the leads. No "attractive package", no "generous commission".

features.title: Why this board
features.payBody: Basic salary, commission rate, and when it is paid — in a structured card above the fold, not buried in the description.
features.leadsBody: Every listing says whether the company provides leads or the consultant generates their own. It is the line consultants care most about, and you can filter on it.
features.seatsBody: One opening or twenty-five? The number is on the card before you open it, so you know what kind of role it is at a glance.
features.freshBody: Every post expires after 30 days, automatically. If it is on the board, it is genuinely open.
features.applyBody: Name, WhatsApp number, experience band. The CV is optional and there is no cover letter.
features.whatsappBody: Employers reach you directly on WhatsApp. Nothing lost to a spam folder.

how.title: How it works
how.candidate1Body: Track, district, experience — and the one that counts: basic salary, or commission only.
how.candidate2Body: Your details are saved, so every application after the first is one tap.
how.candidate3Body: Track where each application stands from your dashboard.
how.employer1Body: Commercial register and tax card. Verification lifts your posting cap and unlocks the consultant directory.
how.employer2Body: The form asks for pay, commission and leads source. That clarity is what brings serious applicants.
how.employer3Body: Every applicant in one pipeline, with a WhatsApp button and a pre-written opener.
how.candidate2Takeaway: You will not retype your details.

agentsBand.title: The consultant directory: you decide who sees you
agentsBand.body: Employed and not ready for your company to know you're looking? Keep your profile completely hidden. Or show it to verified employers only — with no name and no photo for ordinary visitors.
agentsBand.point1: Public, verified employers only, or entirely hidden
agentsBand.point2: Visitors see experience, track and district — no name, no contact
agentsBand.point3: You change it whenever you want

employerBand.title: Hiring real estate consultants?
employerBand.body: Put your role in front of people actually looking in the Egyptian market. Posting is completely free during launch.

employerHero.eyebrow: For real estate companies in Egypt
employerHero.title: Hire consultants who are actually looking
employerHero.subtitle: Post with the salary, the commission and the lead source spelled out. That clarity is what separates a serious applicant from someone trying their luck.

employerWhy.title: Why a listing here brings better people
employerWhy.subtitle: Clarity is not a luxury — it is what saves you interviews that were never going anywhere.
employerWhy.clarityTitle: They know the terms before they apply
employerWhy.clarityBody: Salary, commission and lead source are in the listing, so anyone who applies has already agreed to them. Fewer people walk after the first interview.
employerWhy.nicheBody: Not a general job site. Everyone searching here is searching for property work specifically.
employerWhy.pipelineBody: One list, a status per applicant, a WhatsApp button with the opener written, and CVs behind short-lived links.
employerWhy.verifiedBody: Upload your commercial register and tax card for a verified badge, a higher posting cap, and access to the consultant directory.
employerWhy.seatsBody: One opening and twenty-five are different propositions. The number is on the card, and candidates filter on it.
employerWhy.freshBody: Thirty days and it expires automatically, so nobody applies to a role you filled two months ago.

account.emailPending: Confirmation sent. Open the new address and confirm from there.
